name: Spillway Cascade — Tana River Flood Wave Travel Times

metadata.source: Based on KenGen hydraulic studies and 2024 flood event data
metadata.note: Wave travel time based on average Tana River flow velocity ~15-25 km/hr

properties.Label: ⏱ 6 Hours After Release
properties.Community_Alert: ACTIVE RELEASE from Kiambere Dam. Communities within 30km of Tana River banks must prepare.
properties.Action: Alert authorities, prepare emergency kits, identify evacuation routes

properties.Label: ⏱ 12 Hours After Release
properties.Expected_Reach: Adamson's Falls / Kora National Reserve area
properties.Community_Alert: FLOOD WAVE approaching Kora area. Communities near Tana River in Tana River County must evacuate.
properties.Action: EVACUATE riverine communities. Move livestock. Raise household items.

properties.Label: ⏱ 24 Hours After Release
properties.Community_Alert: FLOOD WAVE approaching Hola. Garissa County DRM offices must activate Emergency Operations.
properties.Action: GARISSA COUNTY: Open Emergency Operations Center. Pre-position food & water supplies.

properties.Label: ⏱ 48 Hours After Release
properties.Expected_Reach: Upper Garissa approaches — Balambala Sub County
properties.Community_Alert: ⚠️ IMMINENT FLOOD for Garissa County. Balambala and Fafi sub-counties — EVACUATE NOW.
properties.Action: ⚠️ ALL RIVERINE COMMUNITIES: Move to designated evacuation points. Schools along Tana to close.

properties.Label: ⏱ 72 Hours — GARISSA TOWN AT RISK
properties.Community_Alert: 🚨 GARISSA TOWN FLOOD RISK. Masinga overflow has reached Garissa. Schools, hospitals, and markets may be flooded.
properties.Action: 🚨 EMERGENCY RESPONSE: DRM + Red Cross + UNICEF + WFP — Deploy emergency teams. Activate all flood shelters.
